scope: Session-lab validation of R8 capacity promotion/exact resume and R9 poly-fractal fracto-recursive continuation using bounded uint64_t plus GMP multi-precision, independent Python oracle, repeated GCC/Clang runs, finite exhaustive corpus, UBSan and ASan.

vectors.role: capacity, recursive, genealogy and context vectors

logs.role: repeated GCC/Clang, oracle, UBSan and ASan observed outputs

fingerprints.role: SHA-256 fingerprints and local persisted bundle digest

results.role: interpreted results, limitations and PFR coverage

limitations: Finite corpus and constructed recursive paths are not universal proofs over all rationals.
Provenance is currently bounded to 32 entries and genealogy to 4096 node identifiers in this experiment.
Only Linux x86_64, GCC 14.2.0, Clang 17.0.0, Python 3.13.5 and GMP 6.3.0 were exercised in this session lab.
Persistence/serialization of live GMP objects is not yet implemented; persisted evidence stores source, vectors and results rather than process memory.
The aggregate session command timeout is an orchestration limit and was handled by rerunning incomplete subtests separately.
PFR-8 remains primarily doctrinal and is not universally proven by this milestone.
